settings.title: Experimental Waze guidance recovery
settings.description: Retry the CarPlay guidance subscription when Waze is identified but maneuver data is missing. Also retry once after a silent CarPlay connection. Does not fabricate directions or override phone capabilities.

settings.title: Extended navigation diagnostics
settings.description: Collect detailed decoded navigation packets, cluster display traces and separate third-party research traces for automatic USB export. Basic session logging remains automatic. Detailed logs may contain private route information.
